'''Hasaq's sun''' was an [[Color/Legends|orange]]-colored [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> located in the [[Hasaq system/Legends|Hasaq system]], a part of the [[Askarian sector/Legends|Askarian sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Nanth'ri Route]], which linked it to the [[Attahox system/Legends|Attahox]], [[Circarpous system/Legends|Circarpous]], and [[Zaloriis system/Legends|Zaloriis systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Both the blade and crystal were unique.''"<br />"''Yeah, unique how?''"<br />"''Orange, like Hasaq's sun.|A possible conversation the Jedi Exile, the player character in ''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords'', can have with Atton Rand|<ref name="KOTOR2" />}}
Hasaq's sun was introduced in the [[2004]] [[Obsidian Entertainment]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''. In the game, the star can be mentioned in an optional conversation the player character, the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]], can have with the character [[Atton Rand]] about the former's [[Meetra Surik's first lightsaber|first lightsaber]].<ref name="KOTOR2" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Hasaq [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the sun, in grid square P-12.<ref name="TEA" />
